name: Taroub
summary: A gallery hang for one garment: on a wide screen the shop's name, a second piece and the pages written as a sentence sit on a left wall; the abaya hangs full height in the middle; its label (name, one line, price, Shop and Find your length) on the right. Below, once, the hem line: shoulder to floor and her shoes in one sentence, the answer in the display face, and a ruler beside a real hem photograph. A quiet ivory bar carries the look and its total. Warm ivory ground, ink, one saffron accent from a crocus stamen; Shippori Mincho for names and answers, Afacad for everything else. For abaya and modest wear boutiques.
